vendor_payments_amount_check.name: vendor_payments_amount_check
vendor_payments_amount_check.value: ("budget"."vendor_payments"."fixed_amount_cents" is not null and "budget"."vendor_payments"."fixed_amount_cents" > 0 and "budget"."vendor_payments"."percentage_basis_points" is null) or ("budget"."vendor_payments"."fixed_amount_cents" is null and "budget"."vendor_payments"."percentage_basis_points" between 1 and 10000)

payment_entries_received_check.name: payment_entries_received_check
payment_entries_received_check.value: "quotes"."payment_entries"."kind" <> 'received' or ("quotes"."payment_entries"."paid_on" is not null and "quotes"."payment_entries"."reverses_entry_id" is null)
